title: Sunday+Night — agency site
abstract: Site for Sunday+Night, the agency Diaz founded in 2017. States its philosophy that "energy is sacred. It is the currency of creation," and that because businesses are "led by humans, operated by humans, to create products and services" for humans, leadership is the most critical business element. Describes a three-part service model — Being + Business Alignment (workshops culminating in a client's own "Magnum Opus"), Brand Expression, and Conscious Creation — and names Diaz "Founding Alchemist," drawing on "25 years of high-level global business and brand expertise." Introduces "Return on Energy" (ROE) as a claimed pathway to ROI.
